title: Evaluation of antigen binding by CD8+ T cells after _in vivo_ treatment with myeloid derived suppressor cells
protocol: Isolate T cells from OT-1 mice using a T cell enrichment column.
Transfer 5-6 X 10^6 isolated T cells intravenously into CD45.1 mice.
On day 3, isolate MDSC from 3-week tumor-bearing mice (EL4 or MC38) using biotin-Gr-1 and streptavidin beads.
Transfer 4-5 X 10^6 isolated MDSCs intravenously into mice which have received OT-1 T cells.
Immunize mice with SIINFEKL peptide at a concentration of 100 ug in 100 ul PBS plus 100 ul incomplete Freund's adjuvant.
Harvest spleens from mice and prepare a single cell suspension.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation (1700 RPM for 5 min) at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 ml/spleen of ACK Lysis Buffer.
Incubate the resuspended cells at room temperature for 4-5 minutes with occasional shaking.
Stop the reaction by adding 40-50 μl of PBS to the incubated cells.
Wash the cells with PBS twice (1700 RPM, 5 min) at room temperature.
Use Cy5-labeled SIINKb-Ig and SIYKb-Ig dimers as specific and non-specific MHC-Ig ligands, respectively.
Prepare a serial dilution of 20 μl of Cy5-labeled MHC-Ig dimer in a FACS tube (2000 nM – 12.5 nM).
Adjust cells to a concentration of 10^7 cells/ml in FACS wash buffer.
Add 10 μl aliquot of adjusted cells to the FACS tube with the prepared MHC-Ig dimer dilution.
Incubate cells with the MHC-Ig dimers for 60-90 minutes on ice.
Add FITC labeled anti-CD8 and PE labeled anti-CD45.1 antibodies to each aliquot.
Incubate cells for an additional 20 min on ice.
Wash cells two times before flow cytometric analysis.
